scope: Original Pascal/Lua DRL in real Chrome; core game-flow gate, not a complete campaign proof

checks.name: Real browser loads pinned original-core artifacts; Japanese default; modern JSPI without experimental feature flags
Original menus validate invalid seed, accept seed 5489, easiest difficulty, Marine, Ironman and exact external name
50 replay draws, font resize, PC viewport change and EN/JA changes preserve every bounded DRLP field and all original MT bytes
Original inventory/equipment and help page scrolling render without simulation/RNG changes
Original settings categories, return/apply and completed settings-file commit work without RNG draws
Physical keyboard movement and wait execute original rules
Actual mobile touch moves once; original 80×25 geometry survives scrolling, fit and 200% UI font without rules/RNG changes
Original Save & Quit witness precedes browser commit; native save bytes have committed SHA-256
Fresh page and Wasm instances execute original Continue game; exact DRLP/RNG restored and native consumed-save deletion persists
Two fresh native-save loads followed by the same physical commands produce identical complete diagnostics and original RNG continuation

actions.screen:
Welcome to D**m the Roguelike!                                             
                                                                                
     You are running DRL for the first time. I hope you will find this          
     roguelike game as enjoyable as it was for me to write it.                  
                                                                                
     This game is in active development (again?), and as such please be         
     always sure that you have the most recent version, for bugs are fixed,     
     new features appear, and the game becomes better at every iteration.       
     You can find the lastest version on DRL website:                           
                                                                                
     https://drl.chaosforge.org/                                                
                                                                                
     Also, if you enjoy this game, join the Discord and/or the forums:          
                                                                                
     http://discord.gg/jupiterhell                                              
     http://forum.chaosforge.org/                                               
                                                                                
     You can also follow me on X (@chaosforge_org/@epyoncf).                    
                                                                                
     Press <Enter> to continue...
